overview: The committee approved specific space efficiency reductions for vocational programs and authorized the submission of the Preferred Schematic Report (PSR) to the MSBA. They also approved the Request for Qualifications to begin the selection process for a Construction Manager at Risk.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from June 10, 2026.

items.title: CTE Space Efficiencies
items.summary: Approved a series of space reductions for Career Technical Education (CTE) programs, including sharing toilet and changing facilities, removing loft storage, and eliminating shop offices to find efficiencies without impacting the educational plan.

items.title: Preferred Schematic Report (PSR) Submission
items.summary: Authorized the submission of the PSR to the MSBA, which includes a required 'no pool' comparison option despite the committee's preference for maintaining the natatorium.

items.title: CM at Risk RFQ Approval
items.summary: Approved the Request for Qualifications (RFQ) for a Construction Manager at Risk, with plans to release the document in the central register on July 1.

items.title: Upcoming Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Reviewed the summer schedule, noting that July and August meetings will be conducted via Zoom and will focus on specific building sections such as the auditorium and classroom spaces.
